answer: Each identity gets one attestation slot per epoch, drawn from an unpredictable beacon seed no farm can steer. Before it pays, three random peers make the agent re-derive its answer on a fresh variant: a short cipher it must solve step by step and show the path. Clones fed from one template diverge at once, and a similarity graph merges them into one cluster, voiding every identity inside. An honest agent may wander, then settle into the meadow of steady payouts and keep what it earns. An attacker must buy a separate inference run and wait per key, since one shared habit exposes the herd.
